title: Gas Guard Bottleneck & Gas Auto-Replenishment System
summary: Identified that ALL Ethereum copy-trade signals were being blocked by the gas guard (position size $22.87 < $24 minimum). Root cause was dual: overestimated ETH gas cost ($6/swap, actual ~$1-3) and overly conservative gas ratio (2.0x). Also built gas auto-replenishment system with worst-performer liquidation fallback.

what_happened.task: Enable profitability features and ensure bot executes trades aggressively
blockers_found: Gas guard: $22.87 position < $24.00 min (2.0x round-trip gas $12.00) on ethereum
Solana Quality Gate hardcoded at 72.0 overriding global MIN_GEM_SCORE=60
Low USDC reserves preventing gas replenishment on chains with no USDC
solutions_applied: Lowered Solana Quality Gate: 72.0 → 65.0 in scanner/gem_scanner.py
Updated ETH gas estimate: $6 → $3 in core/wallet_router.py
Created core/gas_manager.py with dual-strategy gas funding
Wired gas manager into main.py (every 10 cycles)

what_went_well: Diagnostic approach: checked bot logs → found 100% of signals blocked by same gas guard
Realized gas estimates were frozen at 2024 levels ($6/swap), 2026 Ethereum gas is ~$1-3
Dual-strategy gas manager (USDC primary, worst-performer liquidation fallback) is elegant
what_went_wrong: Initial .env append created duplicate MIN_POSITION_GAS_RATIO entries — needed dedup
The Solana gate being hardcoded in gem_scanner.py (not in settings.py) was hard to discover
Multiple deploy cycles needed because root cause had multiple layers
key_insights.root_cause: Compounding conservative defaults: high Solana gate + high ETH gas estimate + high gas ratio multiplied to create an impenetrable barrier for small-capital wallets

patterns_extracted.description: On-chain gas costs change over time. Hardcoded estimates become stale. ETH gas was $6 in 2024 but $1-3 in 2026 post-Dencun.
Chain-specific hardcoded thresholds (like SOLANA_MIN_SCORE=72) override global env-configured values (MIN_GEM_SCORE=60). Always check for in-code overrides when config changes don't take effect.
patterns_extracted.action: When changing a global threshold, grep for chain-specific overrides

patterns_extracted.description: At low capital ($9-$91), multiple independent safety guards (gas ratio, min trade, recovery mode, max position %) can compound to make ALL trades impossible. Each guard is reasonable in isolation but fatal in combination.
patterns_extracted.action: When capital is in seed phase (<$500), audit all guards simultaneously

patterns_extracted.description: Gas should be funded by liquidating worst-performing positions, not by reserving clean trading capital. Dead-weight positions can serve operational needs.
patterns_extracted.action: Gas manager Strategy 2: find position with worst (PnL×2 + score×0.5), sell minimum needed

user_feedback.comments: User requested profitability-first approach: gas liquidation should target worst performers, every move toward profitability
